panel.name: wf_panel
panel.text: The per-cell classification of the census navmesh's own rasterization, shared by the surface, coverage, air and drainage channels. There is no capture of its own: the geometry is the navmesh's span sheets. The dials below tune the classification; a change drops the cached grids and they rebuild under the new setting.

check_box.name: field_enabled_check
check_box.label: Classify the world field
check_box.tool_tip: Off stops the classification and stops the census navmesh keeping its span sheets; every consumer falls back to its own raycasts and heuristics

check_box.name: field_surfacetop_check
check_box.label: Serve the surface field from the field
check_box.tool_tip: The wet/snow/puddle field and runoff read their landing grid from the world field's SURFACE_TOP channel instead of the rain shadow capture. On when you want the field's cells behind the surface sim

check_box.name: field_coverage_check
check_box.label: Serve the soundscape from the field
check_box.tool_tip: The audio mix reads its roof cover, burial and sealed-room verdict from the field's COVERAGE channel instead of the live raycasts. On is what makes tiles build here for audio

text.name: T_field_cell
text.tool_tip: Metres per cell. 0.25 is the navmesh span sheet's own cell, so the grid costs no resampling and window- and door-scale openings resolve for the reach walk; coarser cells cut memory and classification cost quadratically but leak through thin walls

text.name: T_field_angle
text.tool_tip: The outdoors rule, in degrees of sky elevation. An opening hands the covered air behind it gap_height / tan(this) metres of reach, re-evaluated from the local gap height at every step - ground under a sky platform stays outdoors across the footprint, a low room goes interior a few metres past its door. The same length sets how fast enclosure saturates

text.name: T_field_reach
text.tool_tip: How far a query point with no air at its own height - a camera clipped into a wall or into terrain - may walk down looking for one before the field answers open air. A clipping-recovery distance, not a search: too large and a clipped camera adopts a basement's label

button.label: Reclassify now
button.tool_tip: Drop every cached world field grid; each region reclassifies from the navmesh's current span sheets at the current settings
